annotations.title: See who is on the site now

description: Who is on your human's site right now: each visitor's pages so far, what the agent showed them, and its current reading of them. Paid plans only (Pro and up) — on Free it is refused with the way to upgrade. Needs the visits permission. Poll at most once a minute; this has its own budget, separate from the history tools. Bots are judged when a visit ends, so a robot not yet recognised can appear here as a person.

population.description: People (default), AI shopping agents, or both.

siteId.description: Which site this call is about. Only needed when your credential covers more than one — cromanion_grants lists them and says whether it is required. Omitting it with several is refused rather than guessed at.

name: cromanion_live

sessions.description: Each: sessionId (pass to cromanion_visit after the visitor leaves), startedAt, lastSeenAt, ended, controlGroup, visitorKind, device, channel, pages, shown, converted, budget when your human reads it, and `reading` (intent, funnelStage, probability with probabilitySource, objection) — Cromanion's interpretation.
